title: Rest, pool, Nathan Road shopping, lounge, Temple Street
summary: Breakfast from 8am, then rest and pool time. Afternoon: walk up Nathan Road for shopping. Lounge at the hotel for drinks and supper from around 17:30, then Temple Street night market. Big Buddha / Ngong Ping moved to Friday morning.

rows.what: Walk up Nathan Road for shopping
rows.detail: Casual stroll and shopping along Nathan Road before returning for lounge time.
Short walk or MTR one stop to Jordan. Browse stalls, optional dinner (e.g. Hing Kee claypot rice). Cash friendly.

notes: Shifted to Friday morning after breakfast. Peak already done Wednesday.
